protocol.source_selection: cold RZDT2 task at position 1 in each of the three frozen cohorts
protocol.accounting: Learned includes each frozen program's actual Hegel research calls and receives only the remaining total budget for SC-KG. Default receives all 64 calls for SC-KG. Prior calls are already incurred in the source study, and are charged here rather than reacquired.
protocol.evaluation: The original optimizer's final truth report runs only after acquisition and final recommendation freeze. Online truth diagnostics and intermediate truth evaluation are disabled.
protocol.scope: Three-seed full acquisition path smoke on noise-free RZDT2, not independent scientific confirmation or comparison with the current paper method.
